links.comparator_used: Prompt A (adult-directed prompt) versus Prompt B (child-directed prompt), same questions and LLMs
links.effect: Prompt B responses were significantly more readable than Prompt A responses across all LLMs (p ≤ 0.001); no scores given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Prompt B ratings were lower for ChatGPT 4o on correctness (83% vs 91%) and conciseness (63% vs 79%), and potential-harm ratings were slightly worse (97% vs 99%).
links.quote: The responses generated with Prompt B were significantly more readable than those generated with Prompt A across all LLMs (p ≤ 0.001).

design_hint: reading-level constrained prompting for child-friendly output
